dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need me to take you to the hospital?

dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: Oh, it's not like that. I'm just not quite used to life on land yet.

dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: I run an armed commercial shipping company. I used to serve as a lieutenant captain in Beidou's Crux Fleet, and made quite a bit of money doing so.

dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: I haven't ventured back out to sea since starting my own commercial shipping company.

dialogues.speaker: Farzaneh
dialogues.text: But I'm struggling to get used to being back on land, maybe because I spent so long at sea. I have to walk back and forth to avoid getting dizzy...
